item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena stands on soft mud in her school playground wearing flat sandals. She then changes into high-heeled shoes and stands on the same mud with the same body weight.
Which statement about the pressure she exerts on the mud is correct?

options.A: The pressure is greater in the high heels, because the same weight acts on a smaller contact area.
options.B: The pressure is smaller in the high heels, because the weight is spread over a smaller area.
options.C: The pressure stays the same, because her weight does not change.
options.D: The pressure is greater in the flat sandals, because a larger area always gives greater pressure.
